system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

The Chinoike clan are one of the original noble clans tied to the Daimyo of the land of lightning, known for their unique ability to manipulate iron rich liquids, such as blood, their techniques are often infused with the Land of Lightnings philosophy of martial skill. When initiative is rolled, you can create a small incision on yourself, deep enough to draw blood, but otherwise harmless.

If you do, you can select one weapon from the Blade, Thrown, or Flail weapon groups and conjure this weapon, formed entirely of your blood. This weapon gains the Critical and Blood Bound weapon properties and you become proficient in it for the remainder of initiative. If the weapon has the ammunition property, and it cannot be reduced in size, below a d8.

The Blood Bound Weapon property is a unique property unique to weapons formed with this feature.

Blood Bound. Weapons with this property can be used to make weapon attacks using the ability modifier as chosen by your Hijutsu Flexibility clan trait and you cannot be disarmed of this weapon. Other creatures attempting to wield this weapon has it dissolve into a pool of blood. This weapon can be used in place of a Combat Scroll to qualify for a Chakra Stance and if you cast a Bukijutsu with this weapon of C-Rank or lower, you can use either your Ninjutsu or Genjutsu ability modifier, once per turn.
